note: Second fulfilment assertion for this claim in three days, this one on a Bitcoin story dated 10 July. Both rest on the same original word, which still needs dating before either can count.
No date, no cancer named, no threshold for something of the past. The 2027 to 2030 window in the same passage belongs to the internet claim and is not carried over to this one.

He is unsure of his own origin date, four weeks or five, which leaves a fortnight of slack in a claim whose entire force is that the word came before the vote. The vote itself is a dated public event, so the sequence can be settled.
They will overplay their hand and more and more will be seen, with no rate attached. No revival without true repentance supplies in advance the reason for a revival that does not arrive.
Weapons found in tunnels is not an attack. Preparation is being read as partial fulfilment of an event that has not happened, which lowers the bar the claim itself set.
He raises the obvious objection himself, that this was said in 2024 too, and answers that it matters even more now. That answer is available in every cycle, which is what makes it worth recording.
The cleanest test in the batch: one building, one completion date, publicly reported. He says outright he does not know why he sees 2027, which is worth keeping beside it.

An unprompted admission that his accuracy varies with preparation and that a dry day is attributable to household distractions. It also builds in the defence that anyone operating without the switch gets familiar spirits.
Dated on both ends, word in May and fires in July, so the sequence is checkable. The attribution to the Islamic Brotherhood is the part that would need separate evidence and none is offered.
Some you will stop and some you will not covers every outcome in advance, and the Fourth of July detail he says he saw is withheld, which removes the thing that would be checked.
Acceleration of war and of the cleansing, both without a baseline, so neither can be measured. Now past due.

The appearance is datable, 11 July 2025 on a named channel, which makes that half properly checkable. The other half is the broadest unfalsifiability move in the corpus: Daniel's unfulfilled visions are offered as the reason an unfulfilled claim is not a failed one, which retires the deadline from every dated claim at once.
